name: arimono-de-recipe
description: 家にある食材・材料からAIへレシピを相談し、依頼文もコピーできるWebアプリ

scripts.dev:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --ai=AI
scripts.format: biome check --write --error-on-warnings --diagnostic-level=warn --reporter=github --colors=off . && npm run format:markdown && npm run format:yaml
scripts.format:unsafe: biome check --write --unsafe --error-on-warnings --diagnostic-level=warn --reporter=github --colors=off . && npm run format:markdown && npm run format:yaml
scripts.format:check: biome ci --error-on-warnings --diagnostic-level=warn --reporter=github --colors=off . && npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:yaml
scripts.lint: npm run lint:design && biome lint --error-on-warnings --diagnostic-level=warn --reporter=github --colors=off . && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:markdown && npm run lint:yaml
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:structure && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:structure && npm run test:e2e
